notes: SvelteKit: @bugsee/sveltekit adds the server hooks (handle, handleError) and the client hooks, so one session covers the server request and the browser that triggered it. The browser token is PUBLIC_BUGSEE_TOKEN (written to .env, git-ignored, read through $env/static/public); the server hooks read BUGSEE_APP_TOKEN from the environment the server runs in, so export it there (SvelteKit does not copy .env into process.env). Edge targets use registerServerEdge and createEdgeHandle from @bugsee/sveltekit/edge instead. The wizard installs the adapter and hands you the exact wiring for the framework's own files instead of editing them; run it again after pasting and the step is reported as done. An application token is not a secret.
